title: Polish bank transfer details presentation in the purchase flow

requirements.text: Update the customer-facing bank transfer flow so the selected plan context (network, plan name, data amount, and price) is passed into the bank transfer details dialog and displayed clearly at the top of the dialog as a short "Order Summary" block.

quotes: If you'd like, I can help refine how the bank details appear during checkout.

acceptanceCriteria: When a user clicks “Pay via Bank Transfer” on a specific plan card, the bank transfer dialog shows an order summary that matches the clicked plan (network, plan title, data, and displayed price).
The dialog continues to display the configured bank details fields as before.
No changes are made to any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.

requirements.text: Improve the bank transfer details dialog UX to reduce friction: add a single "Copy all details" action (copies bank name, account name, account number, and any optional IBAN/BIC) and provide clear step-by-step instructions in English for completing a bank transfer and confirming payment.

quotes: refine how the bank details appear during checkout

acceptanceCriteria: A “Copy all details” button is available when bank details are present and copies a well-formatted multi-line block to the clipboard.
The dialog includes a concise numbered instruction list (e.g., transfer exact amount, keep proof, contact support for confirmation).
Existing per-field copy buttons continue to work (or are replaced only if the new experience is clearly better and still provides copy capability for all fields).

requirements.text: Add a prominent WhatsApp confirmation CTA inside the bank transfer details dialog that opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message containing the selected plan summary and a prompt for the customer to attach/describe their transfer proof (while keeping the existing global WhatsApp number unchanged: 09033449260).

quotes: refine how the bank details appear during checkout

acceptanceCriteria: The bank transfer dialog includes a button/link that opens a WhatsApp chat to 09033449260 with a prefilled message that includes the plan’s network, plan name, data, and price.
The WhatsApp CTA is only shown when bank details are available and a plan has been selected via the “Pay via Bank Transfer” action.
The existing “Order via WhatsApp” flow on plan cards remains unchanged and continues to work.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
Do not change the WhatsApp phone number (must remain 09033449260).
nonGoals: Do not add new payment providers or replace Stripe checkout.
Do not implement backend changes for bank transfer (this is a UI/UX refinement only).
Do not introduce real-time payment verification for bank transfers.
